name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
summary: In Stranglethorn, the Bloodsail Buccaneers gather strength for an attack. Fleet Master Seahorn will not risk his whole fleet in a counterstrike, so he sends a small crew against their leaders before they can begin.

sections.title: Decapitating the Pirate Fleet
sections.body: Fleet Master Seahorn means to halt the Bloodsail attack before it gains strength. He mocks Fleet Master Firallon's skill at sea, then chooses to strike at the commanders. Seahorn will not risk a full naval battle. Instead, he sends a small crew to Firallon's landing camp to kill Firallon, Captain Stillwater, and Captain Keelhaul. Without their leaders, the buccaneers will be left without command.

faq.q: Who orders the strike on the Bloodsail leadership?
aliases: who gives the bloodsail buccaneers quest
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay orders the strike. He hopes to break the hostile fleet before it can attack.

faq.q: Which buccaneer commanders need to be eliminated?
faq.answer: The targets are Fleet Master Firallon, Captain Stillwater, and Captain Keelhaul, leaders of the Bloodsail forces.

faq.q: Why does Fleet Master Seahorn send adventurers instead of his ships?
aliases: why not send the blackwater fleet
faq.answer: Seahorn believes a capable crew can strike the landing camp and kill the enemy officers. That could bring down the fleet without risking his ships.

faq.q: Where does this clash fit in the broader confrontation with the Bloodsail Buccaneers?
faq.answer: The clash follows the discovery of the buccaneers' written attack plans during the earlier stages of the Bloodsail investigation in Stranglethorn Vale.
